verdict.rationale: Independent hands-on users confirm LaunchDarkly supports multivariate flags, including serving different numeric throttle values (1MB/5MB/10MB) to agents. First-party docs in the pack describe serving flag variations through targeting rules, but never document the supported value types. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of string, number, and JSON flag variation types; evidence of JSON or dynamic-configuration payloads specifically.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve multivariate flags and dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON), not just booleans

citations.quote: Multivariate flags let them throttle agent data (1MB/5MB/10MB)
use flag targeting rules to serve flag variations to different contexts based on their attributes
